register_hf_tokenizer: register a HuggingFace tokenizer class with the mmpretrain TOKENIZER registry using a decorator or direct call
register_hf_model: register a HuggingFace PreTrainedModel or AutoModel class with the mmpretrain MODELS registry for later instantiation
no_load_hf_pretrained_model: use a context manager to temporarily disable loading pretrained weights when building HuggingFace models
build_hf_model_from_config: build a HuggingFace model from config only by passing load_pretrained=False to skip weight loading
register_auto_model_for_causal_lm: use the pre-registered AutoModelForCausalLM builder to instantiate causal language models from the MODELS registry
